limitations: A reviewed transition sample does not mean all 600 frames visually inspected.
Review records bind to auditMediaSha256. Re-encoded files must be reviewed again.
Transitional body overlap, extra arms, duplicated faces, disappearing/migrating equipment are failures even when metrics are below thresholds.
104 reviewed actions were selected for prior source repairs and flagged risk, not a random population sample; do not extrapolate the failure ratio to all960 actions.
9 actions with no severe issue in selected samples are not full-video visual passes.
Newly rerendered media hashes are outside this frozen review; prior failures are retained as history.
Original contact-page files may be overwritten by concurrent reaudits; mismatches are listed in freeze. The100 unique-transition snapshot JPGs retain their viewed hashes.
